notes: MADToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 MAD once to msg.sender, the factory during launch. Transfers have no taxes or burns, and the token exposes no administrative powers or further minting. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
